tasks.label: count-custom-loc
args: $repos = @("Repository/knk-web-api-v2","Repository/knk-web-app","Repository/knk-plugin-v2"); $codeExt = @(".cs",".csproj",".sln",".ts",".tsx",".js",".jsx",".java",".kt",".kts",".gradle",".properties",".yml",".yaml",".json",".sql",".xml",".html",".css",".scss",".md",".ps1",".sh"); $excludeDirs = @("node_modules","bin","obj","dist","build",".git",".next","out","target",".gradle",".idea",".vscode"); $results = @(); foreach ($repo in $repos) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $repo -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $extOk = $codeExt -contains $_.Extension.ToLower(); if (-not $extOk) { return $false }; $pathLower = $_.FullName.ToLower(); foreach ($d in $excludeDirs) { if ($pathLower -match "[\\/]$([regex]::Escape($d.ToLower()))[\\/]") { return $false } }; return $true }; $totalLines = 0; $nonEmptyLines = 0; foreach ($f in $files) { try { $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -ErrorAction Stop; $totalLines += $content.Count; $nonEmptyLines += ($content | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 }).Count } catch {} }; $results += [PSCustomObject]@{ Repository = $repo; FilesCount = $files.Count; TotalLines = $totalLines; NonEmptyLines = $nonEmptyLines } }; $results | Format-Table -AutoSize; "COMBINED_TOTAL_LINES=" + (($results | Measure-Object -Property TotalLines -Sum).Sum); "COMBINED_NON_EMPTY_LINES=" + (($results | Measure-Object -Property NonEmptyLines -Sum).Sum); "COMBINED_FILES=" + (($results | Measure-Object -Property FilesCount -Sum).Sum)
